title: Browser clients cannot sign with WebAuthn-bound device keys
description: Found in Discord profile revision 2026-10-16: a WebAuthn authenticator signs only WebAuthn assertion structures (authenticatorData || clientDataHash), not arbitrary bytes, so a passkey-bound device key cannot directly produce did:webvh log entries, PLC operations, JWS (§13.1.1) or MLS signatures. Affects every browser client. Options to evaluate: software device keys in browser storage with WebAuthn only for unlock; verifiers accepting WebAuthn-wrapped signatures; native apps only for signing. Needs a design decision.
